description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

  • No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking
  • Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)
  • Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation
  • Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)
  • Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)
  • LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

In-House Counsel, Securities & Generalist

About the role

Pacaso is hiring an In-House Counsel to lead our SEC reporting and securities compliance, and to be a trusted generalist partner across the business. You will own the legal side of our periodic filings and disclosure process. You will also support the business on a wide range of other legal matters as they come up.

Roughly half your time will go to securities and governance. The other half will be whatever the business needs, from commercial agreements and real estate to employment, marketing and privacy.

This role suits a lawyer with 3 to 5+ years of law firm or in-house experience in securities or capital markets work who now wants breadth, direct business impact and a seat close to decision-makers. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations and executive leadership.

What you'll do

SEC reporting and securities

  • Own the preparation and review of the company's SEC filings, including annual, quarterly and current reports, proxy statements and offering materials.
  • Lead the disclosure process with Finance and Accounting.
  • Advise on securities law compliance, including offerings, equity issuances and insider trading.
  • Stay current on SEC rules and guidance, and update policies and processes as needed.

Public company governance and compliance

  • Serve as a primary legal advisor on the company's obligations as an SEC reporting company.
  • Support the board and its committees, including meeting materials, minutes and written consents.
  • Maintain governance documents and company policies.
  • Partner with Finance on disclosure controls and related processes.
  • Maintain entity records and good standing across subsidiaries.

Business and general legal support

You will be a true generalist and a day-to-day legal partner to teams across the company, from the front line to the executive team. We need someone who is excited by variety, comfortable learning new areas quickly, and ready to build legal processes as the company grows.

  • Draft, negotiate and manage agreements, including vendor, partnership, technology and services contracts.
  • Support real estate and property-related matters, including entity structuring, transactions and state-by-state regulatory questions.
  • Partner with People on employment matters such as policies, offer and separation agreements, leave and accommodation questions, and wage-and-hour compliance.
  • Advise Marketing and Sales on advertising, promotions, disclosures and licensing requirements.
  • Support privacy and data protection, including policies, vendor data processing agreements and responses to individual requests.
  • Help manage intellectual property, including trademarks, brand protection and software licensing.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, disputes and regulatory inquiries, and manage their budgets and scope.
  • Build scalable legal processes, such as contract templates, intake and approval workflows and playbooks, so the business can move faster with fewer one-off requests.

What you bring

Required

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.
  • 3 to 5+ years of experience at a well-regarded law firm or in-house legal team, with substantial securities or capital markets work.
  • Hands-on experience drafting or reviewing SEC periodic reports and disclosure documents.
  • Working knowledge of federal securities laws and SEC reporting requirements.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, at a law firm or in-house.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar areas of law quickly, and to recognize when to escalate or engage outside counsel.
  • Sound judgment, clear writing, and the ability to explain legal risk in plain terms to non-lawyers.
  • Comfort managing many matters at once with limited supervision.

Preferred

  • In-house or secondment experience at a startup or high-growth company.
  • Exposure to real estate, employment, privacy or intellectual property matters.
  • Experience building templates, playbooks or legal operations processes.
  • Comfort working with non-legal teams as a day-to-day business partner.

Compensation

  • Around $190,000- we will consider experience and location as variables
  • RSU grant

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

  • Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building
  • Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare
  • 401(k) to help you build long-term security
  • Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers
  • Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work
  • Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment

Our Commitment

Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.
